title: Governed Self-Evolution for Autonomous Investing: A Multi-Agent LLM System with an Invariant Core
abstract: arXiv:2610.30557v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLM agents that act on live Web data must combine heterogeneous evidence, remember what they have done and improve from outcomes without weakening their own safeguards. We study this problem in autonomous investing, where every action is irreversible and based on untrusted Web content. We present Steward, a multi-agent LLM system that draws the boundary of self-evolution in its type system. First, nine role-specialised agents decide jointly: four analysts read news feeds, SEC filings, macroeconomic series and market data and emit typed reports, from which a Portfolio Manager sets target positions that a protected Risk Manager audits. Second, a seven-layer shared memory, assembled by code from the system's own record, gives each decision its position context, the market narrative, calibration and the agent's past decisions. Third, the system improves itself by review: code grades every trade and forecast nightly and writes the grades in

translated_title: 面向自主投资的受治理自我进化：一个具有不变核心的多智能体LLM系统
translated_abstract: 作用于实时网络数据的LLM智能体必须整合异构证据、记住自己已完成的工作，并从结果中持续改进，同时不削弱自身的安全防护。我们在自主投资领域研究这一问题——在这一场景中，每个行动都不可逆转，且基于不可信的网络内容。我们提出了Steward，一个在其类型系统中划定自我进化边界的多智能体LLM系统。首先，九个角色专门化的智能体共同决策：四名分析师分别阅读新闻资讯、SEC文件、宏观经济序列和市场数据，并输出类型化报告，投资组合经理据此设定目标头寸，再由受保护的风险经理进行审计。其次，一个由代码根据系统自身记录组装而成的七层共享记忆，为每个决策提供头寸上下文、市场叙事、校准信息以及智能体的过往决策。第三，系统通过复盘实现自我改进：代码每晚对每笔交易和预测进行评分，并将评分写入……
tldr: 该论文提出了Steward——一个面向自主投资的多智能体LLM系统，通过九个角色专业化智能体协同决策、七层共享记忆，以及以类型系统划定自我进化边界的“不变核心”，在行动不可逆且数据不可信的投资场景中实现受治理的安全自我进化。
en_tdlr: The paper presents Steward, a multi-agent LLM system for autonomous investing that achieves governed self-evolution through nine role-specialised agents, a seven-layer shared memory, and an invariant core that bounds self-evolution within its type system, enabling safe self-improvement in irreversible, untrusted-data-driven investment decisions.
